To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the insurance sector is not as technology-driven as other financial sectors, (ii) the regulatory sandbox is a useful tool for the insurance sector to innovate, but it has been used more for refining and improving existing products and services rather than for challenging the meaning of what is an insurance product or service, and (iii) regulatory sandbox may be more useful to insurTechs offering specialised products or providing specialised services where the current regulations may provide a hindrance to early development.
